name: crotamiton
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE: For the symptomatic treatment of pruritic skin and the eradication of scabies.
pediatric: Pediatric Use: Safety and effectiveness in children have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS: CROTAN lotion should not be applied topically to patients who develop a sensitivity or are allergic to it or who manifest a primary irritation response to topical medications.
